messages.author: ba33b235d69ba58d
messages.subject: MSstatsPTM: peptide level comparisons
parts:
Hello, 
Maybe I am missing something, but it appears that the group comparisons are done at protein level, rather than peptide level. I am studying phosphorylations, and want to know exactly which sites in a given protein are changing. Is there a way to analyze that? The protein-level comparison is not helpful for this.
Thanks!
Nikhil

messages.author: 2889aa2e61425c8e
messages.subject: Re: MSstatsPTM: peptide level comparisons
parts:
Hi Nikhil,

If you specify peptide names in the protein name column, MSstats will do peptide-level analysis. (It will be less effective due to larger noise and more extensive multiple testing, but it will work). Also you may be interested in MSstatsPTM, which is specifically designed for post-translational modifications http://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/MSstatsPTM.html

HTH
Olga
